purpose: Choose one independent compute precision for all 14 reference cases without changing the 0.995 cosine requirement.
diagnosticImplementation: Unmodified official Qwen3VLEmbedder.process, torch 2.8.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.1, CPU SDPA, batch 1, use_cache false.
decision: Use unmodified official FP32 computation uniformly for all 2B cases to reduce reference rounding error. Preserve the 0.995 threshold. Retain official BF16 computation and the original 0.97 threshold for 8B because full FP32 weights exceed the available 32 GiB host memory budget. Both references use their locked original BF16 weights.
reproduction: Run tools/qcs-qwen-reference.py twice for 2B with separate external output directories and --dtype bfloat16 or --dtype float32. Inputs and original weights remain identical. The runtime oracle runner compares the reviewed FP32 reference against Q8_0/F16 GGUF without modifying the reference.
